links.comparator_used: Baseline ChatGPT-o3-mini answering without context retrieval (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Answer quality (relevance, factual accuracy, safety, completeness, conciseness) and preference, rated by LLM-as-a-judge (Gemini 2.0 Flash) and by two blinded rheumatologists on a 15% sample
links.effect: RAG significantly outperformed baseline across all criteria (p<0.001) in LLM judge evaluation; rheumatologists confirmed (p<0.001 for accuracy, safety, completeness); RAG preferred by LLM judge in 92.8% of comparisons (p<0.001) and by human evaluators in 71.2%-74.8% (p<0.001)
links.quote: Analysis revealed that the RAG system significantly outperformed the baseline system across all criteria (p<0.001) in the LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.
